title: Optional Coverage Add-Ons: Corrected Term Premium and Billing Correction Worksheet
content:
This worksheet gives the corrected term premium of an Optional Coverage Add-Ons rider on an annually billed base and the billing correction owed on it.

## Definitions

1. **Corrected monthly rate**: the rider's monthly rider premium, as published in the rider premium rate schedule.
2. **Corrected discount rate**: the rider's annual pay discount rate, as published in the rider premium rate schedule.
3. **Corrected annual premium**: twelve times the corrected monthly rate, reduced once by the corrected discount rate, and rounded to the cent. The corrected discount rate acts a single time, as one rate, on twelve times the corrected monthly rate; it is never applied in stages.
4. **Corrected billed share**: the number of days from the later of the rider's term start date and its add date through its term end date, both days counted, divided by the number of days from the term start date through the term end date, both days counted.
5. **Corrected term premium**: the corrected annual premium multiplied by the corrected billed share, rounded to the cent.
6. **Billing correction**: the prorated annual rider premium charged with an entry date in the current term, less any billing correction already credited with an entry date in the current term, less the corrected term premium, rounded to the cent. A result of zero or less posts no billing correction, and a charge below the corrected term premium is never billed up by it. A rider on a real estate contract is owed no billing correction.
7. **Entry dated in the current term**: an entry counts as dated in the current term when the whole months from its date to the correction date are fewer than one more than the whole months from the term start date to the correction date.

## Worked example (hypothetical inputs)

A Bridgewell Well Pump Rider (monthly rider premium USD 8.99, annual pay discount rate 0.10 as published) on an annually billed base with a 365-day term from 1 January through 31 December, added on 2 July. A prorated annual rider premium of USD 97.09 was charged on 2 July, and no billing correction has been credited.

| Line | Working | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Twelve times the corrected monthly rate | 12 times 8.99 | 107.88 |
| Corrected annual premium | 107.88 reduced once by 0.10, rounded | 97.09 |
| Days from 2 July through 31 December, both counted | | 183 |
| Days from 1 January through 31 December, both counted | | 365 |
| Corrected term premium | 97.09 multiplied by 183 divided by 365, rounded | 48.68 |
| Billing correction | 97.09 less 0.00 less 48.68 | 48.41 |

Had a billing correction of USD 48.41 already been credited in the current term, the same working would give 97.09 less 48.41 less 48.68, which is zero, and no further billing correction would post.

## The current-term test (hypothetical dates)

Term start date 1 January; correction date 15 March. The whole months from the term start date to the correction date are 2, so an entry counts when the whole months from its date to 15 March are fewer than 3.

| Entry date | Whole months to 15 March | Dated in the current term |
|---|---|---|
| 2 January | 2 | Yes |
| 10 December of the year before | 3 | No |
